title: Houston says 'Mama, I love you' the day before Thanksgiving

tellings.quote: and I was shocked cuz I had never ever heard heard my son say my name he was 17

plain: Katie Asher, the mother of Houston, a nonspeaking young man in Atlanta, says that the day before Thanksgiving her son, then 17, said "Mama, I love you", and that she was shocked because she had never heard him say her name. She tells it as a mother who was there, in an episode about The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary podcast about nonspeaking people who are said to read minds.
